facts.fact: The UNECA Digital Trade Regulatory Integration profile states Eritrea does not require local data storage and has no infrastructure-related requirements; no date is given for the stated position, so the document's published date (2022-01-01) is used.

The same profile also says in a generic passage that in practice cross-border data sharing requires certain data to be stored locally, naming no law, data kind or enforcer and contradicting its cross-border section; no date is given, so the published date (2022-01-01) is used.
